'''Imperial Rhovland''', formally the '''Imperial Duchy of Rhovland''', is a major [[Northern Alliance]] member and one of the alliance's original powers.

== State Profile ==

Rhovland is described in extracted source material as an imperial duchy with St. Blane as its capital. Its federal administrative language is [[Witersckar]], with [[Geslariena]] and [[Rontzken]] also associated with Rhovlandian regions.

== Alliance Role ==

Rhovland joined Theorin and Vinterholm in the 1839 alliance system that became the Northern Alliance. The alliance defended old-world monarchies and aligned states while balancing threats from Astoria, eastern powers, and later Vesperan expansion.

During the [[Bakorian War]], Rhovland provided covert military support, training, equipment, intelligence, and diplomatic backing to the [[Bakorian Republic]]. That support was limited by the alliance's desire to avoid direct war with [[Astoria]] and by increasing concern about the [[Vesperan Empire]].

== Later Importance ==

Rhovland remained important in postwar maritime politics. The Istragarde framework later failed to resolve the [[Mariposa-Rhovland maritime dispute]] over the eastern [[Straits of Avangard]], showing that the region's security problems survived the Bakorian and Great War eras.
